rules.title: Prohibition of Discrimination Based on a Tenant's Source of Income
rules.quote: Prohibition of Discrimination Based on a Tenant's Source of Income
rules.summary: San Diego prohibits discrimination against tenants based on their source of income when screening or selecting rental applicants.
rules.effective_date_evidence: ("Prohibition of Discrimination Based on a Tenant's Source of Income" added 9-18-2018 by O–20986 N.S.; effective 10-18-2018.)
rules.exemption_note: Owner-occupied rental units are excepted per § 98.0804
